name: adamantyl-THPINACA
summary: Adamantyl-THPINACA (ATHPINACA, AD-THPINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid, which was first reported to Europol in Slovenia in January 2015. It is known as both the 1-adamantyl and 2-adamantyl isomers (SGT-40 and SGT-194 respectively), which can be distinguished by GC-EI-MS. It is banned in Sweden and Russia. Both the 1-adamantyl and 2-adamantyl isomers are specifically listed as illegal drugs in Japan.

pharmacology.en: Like other synthetic cannabinoids, it is thought to switch on the CB1 receptor in the brain, the same receptor THC acts on.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它和其他合成大麻素一樣，會活化腦中的CB1受體，也就是THC作用的受體。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它和其他合成大麻素一样，会活化脑中的CB1受体，也就是THC作用的受体。

uses.en: It has been sold as an ingredient in synthetic cannabis products. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾作為合成大麻製品的成分販售，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为合成大麻制品的成分贩售，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: It exists as two isomers that differ only in which carbon of its diamond-like adamantane cage is attached, and telling them apart needs laboratory instruments.
fact.zh: 它有兩種異構物，差別只在於金剛烷籠中哪個碳是連接點，而要分辨它們需要實驗室儀器。
fact.zhHans: 它有两种异构物，差别只在于金刚烷笼中哪个碳是连接点，而要分辨它们需要实验室仪器。
